name: Circuit Lab
description: Wire batteries, bulbs, switches and buzzers to light a 3D house. Series bulbs glow dim, parallel bulbs glow bright.

about.concept: Systems thinking with electricity: a circuit works only when the loop is closed, and how parts are arranged changes what happens. Series and parallel are seen as dim and bright bulbs before the words are introduced.
about.progression: The first boards ask for one bulb and one battery. Later boards add switches, buzzers, two bulbs in series or parallel, and faults to find, ending with wiring a whole house.
lifeSkills: Persistence when the first try does not work
